limitations: Controller-authored, fixed normal-input schedules and runner produced eight fresh contexts; this was not an autonomous learned/visual policy. The subject received no gameplay hints and no hidden state/hooks were used.

Only the eight 1-second overview sheets were visually inspected in this review. The raw videos were read only for SHA-256 verification; no full-size frames or dense video windows were inspected before the administrative stop.

One-second overviews cannot establish transient feedback, contact, event order, object continuity, causal failure triggers, or successful replay transitions. Their timestamps are approximate; suspicion without reliable pixels remains unknown.

Visible warning/failure/completion UI is not evidence by itself that the exact case subpaths passed. The 390-slow failure/retry-style prompt was visible, but its causal trigger and successful return to play are not established. Completion panels were visible in both viewports; successful terminal/replay journeys remain unverified.
